additional_info.subject: RE: ID0482767-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P8 170000883] Lost OCPP Connection CRM:03431000161
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
I am reaching out in regards of this ticket
ID0482767
opened by end customer for OCPP disconnections on charger
MP/P8 170000883
and outlets being unavailable
.
The issue of the outlets was solved by first level support by rebooting the charger, and the charger is now working correctly.
I analyzed the recurring OCPP disconnections, and noticed that the only symptom displayed is logged as "Connection closed because of missing Pong from server." If at a first glance this could look like an issue from CPO Backend side, I am escalating the topic to R&D to support the analysis and verify if the disconnections could be generated by the charger unable to keep the communication channel opened.
I will provide you feedback as soon as there is an update from R&D side.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
